about_the_game:
FORGET BUTTON MASHING AND COMPLEX COMBOS.

In the world of Mad Bang Bang, arcane power is raw, chaotic, and commanded by the one weapon you've trained your entire life: your voice.

This is a fast-paced, 1v1 mage skirmish where every spell, from the humblest water ball to the most devastating meteor shower, is unleashed by your spoken word. Step into the arena, take a deep breath, and prepare to prove your vocal dominance in a duel where two mages enter, and only one leaves. The thrill of shouting an incantation and watching it erupt on screen is an experience unlike any other.

FEATURES

  • True Vocal Combat: Our advanced speech recognition engine translates your words into devastating power. Whisper a defensive ward to subtly block an attack, or scream "BANG BANG BANG!" to unleash a screen-filling inferno.

  • Master Nine Unique Mages: Choose your champion and their distinct grimoire.

  • A Constantly Evolving World: The launch of Mad Bang Bang is just the beginning. Our roadmap includes new mages, multiplater mode, new arenas, and creation of your own AI.

The Mad Bang Bang tournament is more than a contest of skill - it's the most magnificent form of gaining glory and fame. The greatest mages from every corner of the land gather to prove their dominance, channeling raw magic through voice alone. The prize? The one, the most unique, the most desirable, mystical and probably even mythical THE GOLDEN PANTALOONS.

The arena awaits your voice. Master your incantations, choose your champion, and prepare to scream your way to victory.

Wishlist Mad Bang Bang today!**

short_description: YOUR VOICE MATTERS! Throw away your mouse and keyboard! In the world of Mad Bang Bang, you control magic with your voice. It’s the world’s first game powered entirely by vocal commands. Shout “Bang! Bang! Bang!” and give your opponent hell!
